reviewType: independent read-only source and test review
assertions: The metadata-only control route retains bearer authentication and the same accepted-node, exact asset-id, and content-existence checks as the full byte read.
Every node association receives its own metadata authorization and provenance read; only the immutable digest payload is cached across nodes.
Accepted graph asset rows and digest-addressed content are immutable for this export boundary, so the metadata and later payload reads cannot be redirected by an authored caller.
A partial legacy metadata-only node contributes neither associations nor otherwise-unreferenced cached content.
The provenance filename fallback is nonempty and uses the archive validator's UTF-8 byte limit.
limits: The reviewer did not independently execute tests.
Reported focused test results belong to the implementation owner and remain separate execution evidence.
This assertion is invalid if any scoped file hash changes.
